Shipping & Fulfillment

We drop-ship from partner warehouses inside India unless a listing explicitly mentions international sourcing.

  • Processing: 1-2 business days for paid orders.
  • Domestic delivery: 3-7 business days via Bluedart, Delhivery, or DTDC.
  • Tracking: shared automatically by email/SMS when carrier scans the parcel.
  • Damages: report within 48 hours with unboxing photos to support@69shop.in.

Custom SLA or bulk freight requests can be coordinated through concierge@69shop.in.
